usage: jbus queue remove [-h] [--message THREAD/MESSAGE]
                         [--page SESSION/ENTRY] [--by BY] [--at AT]
                         slug

positional arguments:
  slug

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --message THREAD/MESSAGE
                        the user's own message in T3 Code
  --page SESSION/ENTRY  the user's own send from a Lavish page
  --by BY               the user's name, with --at, for words that were typed
  --at AT               "<YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM ZONE>", when the user said it
